snippet.title: Forsworn - Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description: Take a look at the Reveal Trailer for Forsworn, a tactical turn-based RPG developed by Resummon Studios. Players will fight across a world under the domain of the gods. Assemble mighty synergies, engage in intense battles, and save a realm plagued by divine conflict. Forsworn is coming soon to PC (Steam).
